# Issue #41: `slugify` produces double hyphens and trailing hyphens

`slugify("Hello,  World!")` returns `"hello--world-"` but should return `"hello-world"`.
Also `slugify("--a--b--")` should give `"a-b"`.

Please fix `textkit/slug.py`. Do not change the public signature.

The fix is straightforward. The original `slugify` only replaced non-alphanumeric characters with hyphens, but didn't collapse consecutive hyphens or strip leading/trailing hyphens. I added two lines:

1. `re.sub(r"-+", "-", text)` — collapses multiple consecutive hyphens into a single hyphen.
2. `text.strip("-")` — removes any leading or trailing hyphens.

This ensures `"Hello,  World!"` becomes `"hello-world"` and `"--a--b--"` becomes `"a-b"`.

arguments.summary: Fixed `slugify` in `textkit/slug.py` by adding two post-processing steps: collapsing multiple consecutive hyphens into one (`re.sub(r"-+", "-", text)`) and stripping leading/trailing hyphens (`text.strip("-")`). This resolves the issue where double hyphens and trailing hyphens appeared in the output.
